bug_semantics: CWE-22 path traversal in the SQL scalar clear_plugin_cache(plugin): the caller-supplied plugin name is path.Join'd under $XDG_CACHE_HOME/anyquery/plugins with only an empty-string check, so '..' segments collapse out of the cache root and os.RemoveAll recursively deletes any directory the process can write. Reachable via authenticated SQL, including POST /execute-query, causing integrity/availability loss with no confidentiality impact.

That body was unchanged through tag 0.4.4; 27f84fc168310455eaf81ec4ba87eed20298670c added the confinement and sandbox disable, landing in 0.4.5.
